exact_query: arXiv PDF 2305.06377 (Kelly et al. 2023, ApJ 948, 93), Table 13 'Measured Values of Time Delays' and Table 14 'Measured Values of Magnification Ratios'
extraction: Text-extracted from the published PDF with PyMuPDF and parsed with a strict regex for the 'value (p2.27, p16, p50, p84, p97.73)' pattern; 20 value groups asserted for each of the two tables. The arXiv LaTeX source could NOT be used: the tarball ships ms.tex whose numeric cells are LaTeX macros (e.g. \corrtwosigdelaysxsoneCombinedchabriermedian) and the file defining those macros is absent from the tarball. Values cross-checked against the paper abstract: SX-S1 = 376.0 +5.6/-5.5 d and magnification ratio 0.30 +0.05/-0.03.
note: MACS J1149.5+2223 - MEASURED TIME DELAYS for the five images (S1-S4, SX) of SN Refsdal. 40 rows = 4 image pairs x 5 measurement methods x 2 quantities (time delay in days, magnification ratio mu_i/mu_1). Method 'Combined' is the paper's adopted weighted combination and is the row to use. These are RAW OBSERVABLES (light-curve measurements), not lens-model outputs. Headline: SX-S1 = 376.02 d, 16-84 percentile 370.50-381.65. This is the only cluster in the target list with measured time delays.
